claims.statement: For a tree U rooted at r, adjoining a path r-s-v gives I(T;z)=(1+z)I(U;z)+zI(U-r;z), alpha(T)=alpha(U)+1, I(T-v;z)=I(U;z)+zI(U-r;z), and the new leaf summand is Delta_(p-1)(I(U)-I(U-r)).
claims.scope: Exact recurrence for every finite ordinary tree U and distinguished vertex r; the selector formula is the strict test Delta_p(T-v)<0, and the summand formula uses the original new leaf v and support s.
claims.reason: Proved by partitioning independent sets according to whether the new support s is selected and by applying the original deletion definitions to v.

claims.statement: The exact pendant-P2 recurrence does not by itself establish the full favorable-leaf aggregate inequality at shell |T|=2p+2; the first-descent and complete selector/contribution bridges remain open.
claims.scope: Cycle 2 T5 investigation of the registered first-order shell, with all original leaf tags and the exact strict lower-region and first-descent guards.
claims.reason: The recurrence transfers order and alpha under p to p-1, and the child alpha guard implies the parent guard with a one-unit boundary gap; x can change under attachment (the exact K_(1,4) example has x(U)=2 and x(T)=3), and no complete selector or sum comparison is proved.

limitations: No shell-wide proof or eligible positive complete-sum counterexample is established.
The K_(1,4) example is only a descent-index diagnostic and is not an eligible shell instance at the displayed rank.
The recurrence for the whole-tree polynomial does not determine the selector changes or contributions of all retained original leaves.
No census, external theorem, Lean build, or universal pruning reduction was performed.
